task.title: Enforce agency config in prompt contract and skills
task.summary: Update CodeWiki prompt/system instruction injection and focused skills so agents read .codewiki/config.json and follow configured agency continuation, approval cadence, budgets, and stop gates.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki prompt contract and skills deterministically instruct agents to derive continuation/stop behavior from .codewiki/config.json rather than hard-coding task-level stopping.
acceptance: Prompt contract includes agency config instructions when a CodeWiki project is loaded, referencing agency level, approval cadence, budgets, context reset, and stop gates.
Prompt contract output for a fixture config with agency.level=sprint and approval_cadence=sprint tells agents to continue within sprint until configured stop gates or budget/context bounds.
Focused CodeWiki skills align with config-derived agency policy and no longer imply task-level stopping as the automation boundary.
Task execution remains atomic: one task at a time, with continuation decisions after task-close governed by config.
Regression tests cover prompt contract injection of config-derived agency policy.
non_goals: Do not create UX/report-rendering tasks or tools in this work.
Do not change full agency runner/session orchestration beyond prompt/system contract and skill guidance.
Do not ignore configured stop gates, budgets, or validation/risk blockers.
